verdict.rationale: Atlassian's own docs say Jira can connect to 3,000+ integrations through the Atlassian Marketplace, and name specific apps (Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr) plus first-party integrations with Slack, Figma, Bitbucket and Trello. That matches the story's "thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace" claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience, and in-depth documentation of how a product manager discovers, installs and manages apps.
